question: All six friends are sitting in a row and facing north, H is sitting between D and G whereas B is sitting between L and A. A and D is sitting at extreme ends. Who is sitting between G and B?
solution: All six friends are sitting in a row and facing north. 1. A and D is sitting at extreme ends. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ad7af381db0dd28c76abc095642fb129ea9fd5d211d6cf0176323058318d1f3.png]
